Bug_Details: This null check is unnecessary; the expression can never be null
Bug_Explanation: The null check is unnecessary as the input parameter to the showBug() method is a String and it's guaranteed to be non-null unless explicitly passed as null.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test cases trigger the bug by passing a non-null input to the showBug method of the UnnecessaryCheckNotNullBug class. The unnecessary null check in the showBug method causes the test case to fail when it actually should not.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The provided test cases passed successfully with both non-null and null inputs. This suggests that the unnecessary null check in the Java code is not causing any issues and is not being triggered by the test cases.
